title: Named landform and subfeatures
measure_or_question: Cross-section/planform, visible subfeatures, area/scale, meaningfully corresponding features
rule_or_formula: Review only with both feature-applicable maps/images

title: Surface material / deposit classes
measure_or_question: Published lithology, regolith, layers, sediment size, bedrock context, mineral analyses if measured
rule_or_formula: Source-linked selected material, do not infer from color

title: Geologic process
measure_or_question: Impact; lava emplacement; collapse; fluvial/lacustrine transport; ice models
rule_or_formula: Source applies to precise feature, distinguish proposed vs observed

title: Exploration activity tag
measure_or_question: Mapping; sampling; robotics; sensor test; navigation
rule_or_formula: Activity justified by documentation, never safety approval

title: Slope over same support
measure_or_question: Raster in local projection meters, consistent spatial support and scale

title: Local topographic roughness
measure_or_question: Standard deviation of valid elevations on fixed-radius neighborhood after consistent resampling

title: Window local relief
measure_or_question: Maximum minus minimum within same physical area

title: Geologic unit area
measure_or_question: Digitized geologic whole-fan polygon or source area
rule_or_formula: body-appropriate polygon area; no analogy score alone

title: Channel length density
measure_or_question: Total mapped channels / selected surface area

title: Visible obstacle fraction
measure_or_question: Same detection threshold and measured-resolution surface imagery

title: Lighting and permanent shadows
measure_or_question: Latitude season terrain shadow geometry; local solar horizon
rule_or_formula: Keep unscored; Moon south pole very different from Arctic summer

title: Ice / water and subsurface geometry
measure_or_question: Ground truth radar/geology/sampling for water ice / lava cave
rule_or_formula: Do not infer subsurface from surface DEM

title: Effective spatial resolution
measure_or_question: Native GSD, interpolated areas, source dates and quality flags
rule_or_formula: Native resolution is NOT output-pixel spacing

title: Vertical reference / coordinate systems
measure_or_question: Earth EGM96 vs Moon reference radius vs Mars are different vertical datums
rule_or_formula: Absolute altitude differences across planets forbidden
